proposition: The next year, during Shāhrukh's campaign against the Qara Quyunlu in Azarbayjan, Ibn Turka obtained a hearing at the sultan's camp at Ṣāʾin Qalʿa near Sultaniyya and received a promise of reinstatement.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (1431-32), addressed to Bāysunghur
mediation.note: the page cites no note; the promise is known only from Ibn Turka's own account as far as the pages read
